description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Torentify is seeking a Full Stack Engineer for a remote consulting engagement supporting a boutique AI consultancy. The role focuses on maintaining cloud-based applications, supporting production services, and developing backend and frontend functionality using Python and/or Node.js, React, and TypeScript.
Full Stack Engineer maintaining cloud applications, building Python/Node.js backends, supporting React/TypeScript frontends, and troubleshooting production services

Responsibilities:
• Maintain and enhance existing cloud-based applications
• Troubleshoot bugs, implement fixes, and support production services
• Develop backend functionality using Python and/or Node.js
• Support frontend development using React and TypeScript
• Collaborate with DevOps engineers on AWS-based deployments

Requirements:
• 1–3+ years of professional experience
• Professional experience with Python, TypeScript, Node.js, or React
• Experience building or maintaining APIs and web applications
• Familiarity with AWS or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)
• Strong debugging and problem-solving skills
• Must be a U.S. citizen and reside in the United States
